preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 100,000.
Each binary string S must have a length between 1 and 1,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '01' for c in S)
preconditions.description: Each character in the binary string S must be either '0' or '1'.

postconditions.description: The output must be the minimum number of operations required to make all characters of S equal.
